name: Aozora Stripe
source:
Shinya is working as a cook-in-training. One day, his mentor and employer Daigo told him that his old acquaintance Kyouko badly needed help at her restaurant since she was injured. Daigo sent him to save the restaurant Marine House Aqua and informed him that it would serve as the final test of his training. Shinya was elated that this moment of his dreams had finally arrived. He struggled in his new position, but the girls in the restaurant all try to help him out. His relationships with them grow closer and his summer love story has begun.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
真也在当厨师学徒。某天，他的师父兼雇主大吾告诉他，他的旧识京子因为受伤急需人帮忙经营餐厅。大吾派他去拯救海洋之家水族馆餐厅，并告诉他这将作为他培训的最终测试。真也为梦想中的这一刻终于到来而欣喜若狂。他在新职位上挣扎着，但餐厅里的女孩们都尽力帮助他。他与她们的关系越来越亲密，他的夏日恋爱故事就此开始。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/08/01/august-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
